title: A Charlie Brown Christmas Live On Stage
seo_title: A Charlie Brown Christmas Live On Stage
description: This touring stage production of A Charlie Brown Christmas brings Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Lucy, Linus and the Peanuts gang to life as they put on their own Christmas play and discover the true meaning of the season. Adapted from Charles M. Schulz's Emmy and Peabody Award-winning animated special, it features the music of Vince Guaraldi. It's meant for the whole family, and all patrons need a ticket regardless of age.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
